name: Ice Spikes
description: Upon taking physical damage, sharpened spikes deal ice damage to the attacking opponent, potentially slowing them.
effects: Upon taking physical damage, sharpened spikes deal ice damage to the attacking opponent, potentially slowing them.

source_abilities.name: Ice Spikes
source_abilities.description:
Counters enemies with ice damage every time you suffer physical damage.
Counter Potency: 40
Duration: 15s
Effect cannot be stacked with Veil of the Whorl or Schiltron.
Additional Effect: 50% chance that when you are struck, the striker will be afflicted with Slow +20%
Duration: 15s
